title: Band geometry flags
description: data/<city_id>/trim.json. Written by build:data from the frozen segments.geojson and config/band-geometry.json; never edited by hand. One entry per segment_id: how far to cut each side band at both ends, whether the block is a sliver, and which sides face another block closely.

trim_start_m.description: Metres to cut from the first-coordinate end of each band.

trim_end_m.description: Metres to cut from the last-coordinate end of each band.

sliver.description: Block shorter than 20 m: drawn only if it has a rule row.

inner_L.description: Another block lies close beside the left side, so it is not drawn.

inner_R.description: Another block lies close beside the right side, so it is not drawn.
